author: asi-evin
issueText: Reviewed manual canary for issue 37360: on iOS, dismissing a Shell modal and pushing a detail page from Shell.Navigated can deliver a pop notification to the root and disconnect its handler. Run a normal push/pop control first, then up to three modal-dismissal/detail-return cycles. Observe the real root handler and root NavigatedFrom event; do not inject either outcome. This new candidate has not yet been executed and is not proof of the original app's blank-page interaction.
